# core/boxed.bastio

<!-- Generated by tests/libref.py from core/boxed.bastio: edit the source, then run tests/libref.py --write. -->

A box that reports running out of memory.

`import "core/boxed.bastio";`

Every example below is built, verified and run by `tests/run.sh`. An `assert` in one is proved at compile time from the contracts above it.

## Types and constants

### `Boxed`

```bastio
enum Boxed[T] { Ok(Box[T]), Full(T) }
```

What `try_box[T](x)` gives back: `x` in a new box, or `x` itself when
there was no memory for the box, so the value is never lost.

Example:

```bastio
let mut v = 0;
match try_box[u64](7) {
  Boxed::Ok(b) => { v = unbox(b); },
  Boxed::Full(x) => { v = x; },   // no memory for the box: the value comes back
}
if v != 7 { return 1; }
```
